Excellent! The logs reveal the problem very clearly. I can see:
1. Producer throttling from the Kafka broker (multiple THROTTLE warnings with 2-3 second throttle times)
2. Producer queue at 96% full
3. Consumed rate (41,880/min) is higher than produced rate (41,610/min), leading to growing consumer lag
4. Average produce throttle time of 2.8s

The issue is that the application is being throttled by the Kafka broker. Let me search for documentation on Kafka producer throttling to understand the implications and best practices:

input.query: Kafka broker throttling producer rate limit
